description: The PF13-PF24 wrap-around of app/cpy/CSSTRPFY.cpy, taken on a key the ladder folds onto one COCRDLIC HONOURS. DFHPF19 is a distinct AID from DFHPF7 - two separate constants in common/CicsAid, whose byte values are deliberately NOT restated here because DFHAID is IBM-supplied and absent from this repository despite its seventeen consumers, so those bytes live in that one class sourced from IBM CICS documentation and this fixture names the mnemonics rather than inventing numbers (risk R-D) - and the ladder's twenty-third arm [CSSTRPFY.cpy:66-67] sets CCARD-AID-PFK07, the very condition DFHPF7 sets at :42-43, because app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy declares only PFK01 through PFK12 and keys 13 to 24 have nowhere else to go. PFK07 is then one of the four keys :371-374 accepts, so :375 sets PFK-VALID, the coercion at :378-379 does NOT fire, and the transaction answers 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY' exactly as a real PF7 does. This expectation is therefore byte-identical to case06's - same inputs, same commarea, same map items, same 45-field send, same 50 unchanged rows - and only three members differ: caseId, description and screenRequest.aid. That identity IS the assertion. Against case01, the ENTER page-one baseline, the same projection agrees on 36 of the 45 fields and diverges on exactly nine, none of them by accident: the seven CRDSELnO items hold LOW-VALUES here where a cold start shows a space, because :972-978 moves the untransmitted CRDSELnI items into WS-EDIT-SELECT on a re-entry while INITIALIZE at :301 blanks WS-EDIT-SELECT-FLAGS on a first entry; and INFOMSGO with ERRMSGO carry the different 1400-SETUP-MESSAGE arm, which is the fold made visible. case06 rather than case01 is therefore the honest comparator, because it is the one case that differs from this one in the AID alone. PROVENANCE (practice B12): every value here is STATICALLY DERIVED from app/cbl/COCRDLIC.cbl [:300-302, :315-332, :336-343, :348-350, :357-362, :370-380, :410-414, :418-445, :572-583, :604-619, :624-637, :642-672, :678-744, :837-889, :895-932, :938-947, :1003-1013, :1036-1048, :1073-1117, :1123-1260], the whole of app/cpy/CSSTRPFY.cpy, app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy:3-19, the byte layout of app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy, the title literals of app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:18-22, the commarea of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the symbolic-map items of app/cpy-bms/COCRDLI.CPY with app/bms/COCRDLI.bms, and the real fixture app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt - and NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution, which the eight verified blockers of AAP 0.7.6 make impossible in this environment (risk R-A, AAP 0.9.11). No user rules exist for this project - review_rules returns exactly the one line 'No user rules provided.' and that line is the whole document - so nothing is forced into scope by a rule and AAP 0.10.2's enterprise practices govern instead. Encoding is US-ASCII, named explicitly and never the platform default (practice B8), and the clock is pinned to the same 2022-07-19T23:12:34 as case01 so CURDATEO renders 07/19/22 and CURTIMEO 23:12:34 on every run (practice B7). THE LADDER AS MEASURED, WHICH IS LARGER THAN THE PLAN DESCRIBES (practice B4): AAP 0.4.3 has CSSTRPFY evaluating EIBAID against DFHENTER, DFHCLEAR, DFHPA1, DFHPA2 and DFHPF1-DFHPF12. Counted by hand from the copybook, YYYY-STORE-PFKEY [:17] is an EVALUATE TRUE [:21] with TWENTY-EIGHT WHEN arms and NO WHEN OTHER, ending at END-EVALUATE [:78]: arm 1 DFHENTER [:22-23], arm 2 DFHCLEAR [:24-25], arm 3 DFHPA1 [:26-27], arm 4 DFHPA2 [:28-29], arms 5-16 DFHPF1-DFHPF12 onto PFK01-PFK12 [:30-53], and arms 17-28 DFHPF13-DFHPF24 onto PFK01-PFK12 again [:54-77]. There is no DFHPA3 arm, matching CVCRD01Y's absence of a PA3 predicate. Through that table PF15 behaves as PF03 and exits [:384-406], PF19 as PF07 and pages up, and PF20 as PF08 and pages down. A second count is corrected the same way: DFHPF20 is the TWENTY-FOURTH arm, at CSSTRPFY.cpy:68-69, not the twenty-eighth - arm 28 is DFHPF24 onto PFK12 - and DFHPF19 is arm 23. And CVCRD01Y.cpy:3-19 declares SIXTEEN 88-level conditions over CCARD-AID PIC X(5), not fifteen: ENTER, CLEAR, 'PA1  ' and 'PA2  ' - both literally space-padded to five bytes, where a naive "PA1" would be a three-byte value the condition never matches - then PFK01 through PFK12. The counts in the prose are recorded and left alone; the copybook is the contract. THE GATE, AND WHY A COERCED KEY IS SILENT [:370-380]: SET PFK-INVALID TO TRUE, then IF CCARD-AID-ENTER OR CCARD-AID-PFK03 OR CCARD-AID-PFK07 OR CCARD-AID-PFK08 SET PFK-VALID TO TRUE, then IF PFK-INVALID SET CCARD-AID-ENTER TO TRUE. Four keys are honoured and everything else - CLEAR, PA1, PA2, PFK01, PFK02, PFK04-PFK06, PFK09-PFK12, and the 'no predicate set at all' state an unnamed AID leaves behind because the ladder has no WHEN OTHER and never clears CCARD-AID - is SILENTLY rewritten to ENTER and lists cards. There is no error message, no cursor move and no highlight on that path. In particular, although COCRDLIC copies app/cpy/CSMSG01Y.cpy at :281, a search for CCDA- in the program returns only :647 and :648 - the two screen titles - so the invalid-key literal that copybook declares as CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY PIC X(50) at CSMSG01Y.cpy:20-21 is copied and NEVER referenced by this program. It is preserved unreferenced (practice B5), and its text is deliberately not reproduced anywhere in this file - not in the expectation and not in this prose - so that no reader and no grep can mistake it for something this screen emits (practice B1). WHY THIS CASE ENCODES ONE PROBE, AND WHICH: the frozen ParityCase contract carries exactly one AID - ScreenRequest.aid is a single String validated against common.CicsAid's mnemonics - and there is no expectedRecords member to split two probes across, only expectedWrites and expectedFinalState, which carry records rather than keys. So one probe is expressible and the aliased one is encoded here. It is DFHPF19 rather than DFHPF20, for three measured reasons stated rather than buried (practice B4). FIRST, the page-down arm cannot be reached from any case file: WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK08 AND CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS [:486-487] needs WS-CA-NEXT-PAGE-IND 'Y', which lives in WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA [:229-248] and not in CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, and ScreenRequest's commarea admits only CDEMO- names - case02, which presses a REAL DFHPF8, records the same finding and pins :486-497 including ADD +1 TO WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM [:492] in COCRDLICParityTest's pageDownAdvancesOnlyByPayloadCursor instead. SECOND, and decisively, PFK08 would make the fold UNFALSIFIABLE: with seven rows seeded the look-ahead ENDFILEs and 1400-SETUP-MESSAGE's :910-916 arm wins, with eight or more it is :917-919, and a DFHPF20 coerced to ENTER because the fold had been dropped reaches :917-919 in both arrangements and paints the SAME ERRMSGO, INFOMSGO and INFOMSGC - the only divergence, SET CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN at :915, is outbound-cursor state and is equally inexpressible. A case that would still pass with the fold deleted does not pin the fold. THIRD, PFK07 is falsifiable: the fold puts this key on the PF7 path, so ERRMSGO carries the error and INFOMSGO stays blank with the DFHBMDAR of :671; drop the fold and the key coerces to ENTER, takes WHEN OTHER [:572] and :917-919, and all three fields change. The coerced probe is not lost - case04 pins DFHCLEAR through CSSTRPFY.cpy:24-25 and case07 pins DFHPF13 folding onto PFK01 and then being coerced, and COCRDLICParityTest's pfKeyLadderFoldsAndUnnamedAidsBecomeEnter drives DFHPF13, DFHPA3, DFHCLEAR and DFHPF5 to ENTER and asserts DFHPA3 resolves to nothing at all. What none of them has, and what this case adds, is a fold onto an ACCEPTED key, which is the only arrangement that proves the fold runs BEFORE the gate and that the gate then honours the folded value. ENTRY STATE: :300-302 INITIALIZE CC-WORK-AREA, WS-MISC-STORAGE and WS-COMMAREA; :307 moves CCLI to WS-TRANID; :311 SET WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF. EIBCALEN is greater than zero so :326-331 takes the commarea apart, and the re-init guard at :336-337 is false because CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-THISPGM. eibcalen is stated as LENGTH OF CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, 160, in line with COCRDLIC's other re-entry cases; recorded rather than corrected (practice B4), what CICS would report here is 2000, because COMMON-RETURN returns COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA) LENGTH(LENGTH OF WS-COMMAREA) [:615-618] over WS-COMMAREA PIC X(2000) [:262], of which only the leading 218 bytes are meaningful - CARDDEMO-COMMAREA 160 summed by hand from COCOM01Y plus WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA 58, itself 27 + 27 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 from :230-248. Nothing behavioural rests on the number: :315, :357 and :839 test it only against zero. Because EIBCALEN is greater than zero and the from-program is this program, :357-362 performs 2000-RECEIVE-MAP: both filters arrive untransmitted, so 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT takes its not-supplied branch [:1007-1012] and 2220-EDIT-CARD takes its [:1042-1047], each zeroing its CDEMO- field, and 2250-EDIT-ARRAY's INSPECT TALLYING [:1079-1082] counts I = 0 so the more-than-one-action branch [:1084-1095] is skipped and the EVALUATE at :1100 takes WHEN SELECT-BLANK [:1106-1107] seven times - the 88-level names both a space and LOW-VALUES - leaving INPUT-ERROR unset and I-SELECTED zero. THE SECOND PLACE THE AID IS READ [:410-414]: IF CCARD-AID-PFK08 CONTINUE ELSE SET CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN TO TRUE. PFK07 is not PFK08, so the ELSE runs and the flag holds 9, the value 88 CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN names at :241. A folded PF20 would take the CONTINUE instead, which is the one place the two folds visibly part company. DISPATCHER (gate G30, source order preserved): the EVALUATE at :418 is ordered and the order decides. WHEN INPUT-ERROR [:419] is false. WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK07 AND CA-FIRST-PAGE appears TWICE in succession, at :439-440 and again at :444-445, separated only by the comment block at :441-443; the first carries no statements, so under COBOL multi-WHEN semantics it shares the second's body and the redundant duplicate is preserved as two conditions rather than collapsed (practice B5). The arm matches because the payload cursor arrives in the first-page state, WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM 1, which satisfies 88 CA-FIRST-PAGE VALUE 1 [:238] with no server-side state consulted (rule R6, gate G37). Its body moves WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM to WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM [:446-447], performs 9000-READ-FORWARD - forward, not 9100-READ-BACKWARDS - and touches WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM by neither ADD nor SUBTRACT, unlike :492 and :508, so PAGENOO stays 1 [:667]. The commented-out MOVE at :448-449 and PERFORM 1000-SEND-MAP THRU 1000-SEND-MAP at :452-453, whose range end equals its range start where :495-496 writes THRU 1000-SEND-MAP-EXIT, are both left standing (practice B4). GO TO COMMON-RETURN [:454] is a benign shared-terminal jump, restructured to a return after the shared finalisation at :604-619 with the fall-through outcome unchanged (rule R7), as is PERFORM YYYY-STORE-PFKEY THRU YYYY-STORE-PFKEY-EXIT [:348-350], a range-perform collapsing to one method call. BROWSE: :1124 blanks WS-ALL-ROWS; STARTBR GTEQ [:1129-1136] anchors on the first key at or after WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM, which is blank and sorts below every key, so the browse opens at the top of the file; :1140 zeroes WS-SCRN-COUNTER and :1141 sets CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS before a record has been read. The READNEXT at :1146 reports the NORMAL outcome of common/FileStatus seven times, WHEN DFHRESP(NORMAL) and WHEN DFHRESP(DUPREC) sharing one body [:1157-1158]; 9500-FILTER-RECORDS excludes nothing because both filter flags are blank, so ADD 1 TO WS-SCRN-COUNTER [:1163] runs seven times; row one's key 0500024453765740 becomes WS-CA-FIRST-CARDKEY [:1174-1176] and the bump at :1177-1178 is skipped because WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM is 1 and not 0. At WS-SCRN-COUNTER = WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES [:1191] the loop exits, :1194-1195 stores row seven's key 1142167692878931, and the look-ahead READNEXT [:1197-1205] also reports NORMAL because row eight exists, so :1208-1214 keeps CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS and replaces the stored key with 1561409106491600. ENDBR at :1258. Both read sites are driven from seeded rows alone and nothing is forced (gate G47). FIXTURE ARITHMETIC, MEASURED: carddata.txt holds 50 rows of 150 bytes, already ascending by CARD-NUM as a KSDS browse returns them, every CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS 'Y' and every FILLER 59 spaces. At seven to a page the boundaries are rows 1-7 and rows 8-14, with keys 0500024453765740, 1142167692878931, 1561409106491600 and 3260763612337560. THE MESSAGE (gate G30 again): 1400-SETUP-MESSAGE's EVALUATE [:897] is ordered. Arms one and two, FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK and FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK [:898-900], do not match. Arm three [:901-904] does - CCARD-AID-PFK07 AND CA-FIRST-PAGE - and moves 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY' into WS-ERROR-MSG. It precedes both PFK08 arms [:905-916] and WHEN CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS [:918], so it wins even though the look-ahead has already made that last condition true; reversing the two would substitute the 'TYPE S FOR DETAIL' prompt for the error. Because the AID was folded and NOT coerced, this arm is reached at all - which is the whole point of the case. Arm three sets no WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS, so WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE still holds from :669 and the guard at :926-927 is false: INFOMSGO keeps the 45 spaces of :670 and INFOMSGC keeps the DFHBMDAR of :671 rather than the DFHNEUTR of :929 (practice B5). ERRMSGO is the 28-character literal in WS-ERROR-MSG PIC X(75) [:117] moved at :924 into ERRMSGO PIC X(78), right-padded with 47 spaces to 75 and then with 3 more to 78. The ranges are cited as measured: the paragraph is :895-932 with its EVALUATE at :897-922 and its guard at :926-930, where the brief for this file says :897-923 and :926-931 (practice B4). SCREEN: :643 MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CCRDLIAO paints the output group x00 and not spaces, which is why ACCTSIDO, CARDSIDO, every CRDSELnO and CRDSTP2O through CRDSTP7O are expected as LOW-VALUES; 1200-SCREEN-ARRAY-INIT [:678-744] moves only four items per populated row - CRDSELnO, ACCTNOnO, CRDNUMnO and CRDSTSnO - so no CRDSTPnO is ever written by the program, a decisive expectation rather than an oversight (practice B5), and row one has no CRDSTP1 item to write at all [COCRDLI.CPY:73-96]. Every CRDSELnO carries LOW-VALUES because 2100-RECEIVE-SCREEN moves the untransmitted CRDSELnI items into WS-EDIT-SELECT [:972-978] and :683 onward moves them back out. Because this is a re-entry, 1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS takes the ELSE at :843 and its ordered EVALUATEs land on WHEN CDEMO-ACCT-ID = 0 [:849-850] and WHEN CDEMO-CARD-NUM = 0 [:861-862], the two fields the blank-filter branches zeroed at :1011 and :1046, so both filter fields stay LOW-VALUES. INPUT-OK holds, so :884-885 aims the cursor at ACCTSIDL. The projection is exactly 45 fields - 9 header, 4 for row one, 5 each for rows two to seven, and 2 footer - every width taken from an xxxI PICTURE clause of COCRDLI.CPY (practice B11), and COCRDLI declares no FKEYS item, so none is pinned. The xxxL, xxxF and xxxA items are length, flag and attribute metadata and are not payload fields; ACCTSIDL appears as cursorField because COBOL positions the cursor by moving -1 into the length item. NO HIGHLIGHT, BY DERIVATION (gate G38): a folded or coerced key is not a validation failure. 2000-RECEIVE-MAP runs, but both filters take their not-supplied branches, every row is SELECT-BLANK, INPUT-ERROR is never set, and so neither 1250-SETUP-ARRAY-ATTRIBS' DFHRED nor the '*' of the CSSETATY pattern appears - COCRDLIC does not copy CSSETATY at all and drives its own per-row flags instead. SCREEN STATE (gate G34): CCARD-AID and its sixteen predicates live in CardScreenState, whose span is 213 bytes summed by hand from CVCRD01Y.cpy - 5 + 8 + 7 + 7 + 75 + 75 + 11 + 16 + 9 - alongside three REDEFINES pairs over one backing span each, CC-ACCT-ID with CC-ACCT-ID-N [:34-36], CC-CARD-NUM with CC-CARD-NUM-N [:37-39] and CC-CUST-ID with CC-CUST-ID-N [:40-42]. CCARD-RETURN-MSG-OFF is VALUE LOW-VALUES [:30] - never spaces and never Java null. The AID travels in that payload and nothing is remembered server-side, so the fold and the gate are re-evaluated on every request (rule R6, gate G37). RECORDS: CARDDAT is the one dataset key this program reaches (gate G45); CARDAIX, declared as LIT-CARD-FILE-ACCT-PATH at :215-217, is never opened by COCRDLIC and is preserved declared-but-unused - an alternate index is a second access path on one repository and never a second table. All fifty seeded rows are pinned unchanged, which is a positive assertion rather than an omission: a browse-and-return transaction must leave the card master exactly as it found it, and expectedWrites is empty for the same reason. Each image is 150 bytes summed by hand from app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy - CARD-NUM 16, CARD-ACCT-ID 11, CARD-CVV-CD 3, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME 50, CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE 10, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS 1, FILLER 59 (practice B11, gates G19 and G21). Rows 0, 6 and 7 - the browse anchor, the row whose key :1194-1195 stores, and the look-ahead record that replaces it - are additionally pinned span by span, so the misspelled CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE at offsets 81-90 is asserted BY NAME exactly as the copybook spells it (requirement I1) and the FILLER at 92-150 is asserted as 59 spaces rather than merely implied by the total width. PAGE SIZE: seven, from WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES PIC S9(4) COMP VALUE 7 [:177-178] with the three OCCURS 7 TIMES at :76, :86 and :255. It is behaviour and not configuration (gate G39), so this fixture declares no page-size key of any spelling, and no jobParameters at all, which a CONTROLLER_POJO may not carry in any case. It seeds no under-width fixture, so it declares no normalisation: carddata.txt is already at its copybook's 150 bytes, unlike cardxref.txt. NOT APPLICABLE HERE, stated so the absence is deliberate: gates G32 and G35 have no subject in this program. Every GO TO in COCRDLIC is a forward early exit or the shared terminal COMMON-RETURN, with no backward loop-forming jump - CBSTM03A is the only program that has one - and RETURN-CODE, CEE3ABD and ABEND occur zero times in the source, so an unhandled or folded key does not abend and expectedReturnCode is 0 with no message emitted on any channel. None of the three XCTL sites at :402, :538 and :566 is reached, so nextProgram, nextMapset and nextMap are absent and the termination is the RETURN_TRANSID of :615-619 with exactly one send. The AID mnemonics DFHENTER, DFHCLEAR, DFHPA1, DFHPA2 and DFHPF1 through DFHPF24 are referenced BY NAME through common/CicsAid, which reproduces them from IBM CICS documentation because DFHAID is absent from this repository despite its seventeen consumers (risk R-D); no numeric AID byte is invented in this file. One last divergence is recorded rather than reconciled (practice B4): *COPY COCRDSL. at :274 is COMMENTED OUT, so COCRDLIC does not copy that symbolic map even though AAP 0.2.3 lists it as copied by both COCRDSLC and COCRDLIC. GATE: this is one of the twenty cases COCRDLIC must satisfy and the module is not complete until the diff count is zero across all twenty of them (gates G15 and G18). The unit is reached as a plain object with no HTTP in the path (gate G51).
